title: Mediocre
text: Mediocre. Nothing really special about these pillows. They aren't incredibly poofy an soft. They are a medium loft and don't squish down when you lay your head on them. The cotton cover is nice, I don't see a bunch of feathers sticking out either. Usually when I get down products, I'm super excited about them and they quickly become my favy. These pillows are going to end up off my bed and into the guest room tho.
